question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the fourth term is related to the third term and the second term is related to the first term. 

DOLPHIN : ALIMEFK :: GROUP : DOLRM :: SHARK : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

DOLPHIN : ALIMEFK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56438cdabcc4c4db927a7f8121944db8aaf4df5db7a33e92207142a9dbe3898d.png] 

And,

GROUP : DOLRM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a43a98533667a99fa02efb0a5de43c25bad1aa47b70c9458ab21010ac537cc7.png] 

Similarly,

SHARK : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/752fb83aaf099927c2f31f9c8da663ad14bd862e932f1abb2545975617033b6d.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
